findings.description: Structural decisions with no ADR: (1) sc-treesitter library depends unconditionally on mimalloc; (2) published library crates carry exact = pins (sc-observability* =1.5.0 reaching sc-agent-types/sc-ai/sc-jev-py; mimalloc =0.1.52; tree-sitter*); (3) sc-treesitter ships as a second released binary (crates.io, archives, Homebrew). Only docs/development/sc-publish.md:120-136 records this and defers to 'the Phase A architectural review'. ADR-SAG-0016 says '1.5.0' (caret) while workspace uses '=1.5.0'.
findings.remediation: New Active ADR recording pin policy, allocator policy, and the second binary; amend ADR-SAG-0016 version text. (Owner decision — see deep review.)

findings.description: ADR-SAG-0017 describes 'sc-ai binary' on Homebrew/Scoop/WinGet; consumer input also ships sc-treesitter in release_binaries and Homebrew but Scoop shims only sc-ai.exe and WinGet names only randlee.sc-ai. ADR outgrown; channels inconsistent.
findings.remediation: Amend ADR-SAG-0017 to name every shipped binary and per-channel coverage; fix Scoop/WinGet inputs or state why they differ.

findings.description: Confirmed drift: allowed_dependencies=[sc-agent-types] but crate depends on mimalloc, serde_json, tree-sitter*; forbidden_edges=[] does not encode 'no sc-jev-check/sc-jev/judge crate' from docs/sc-treesitter/architecture.md:5.
findings.remediation: List externals or state crate-only convention; add forbidden_edges sc-treesitter -> sc-jev, sc-jev-check, sc-jev-backends, sc-agent-secrets; forbid grammar crates in jev-check per ADR-SAG-0015.

findings.description: Boundary files follow no single rule for external crates: sc-ai lists sc-observability but not mimalloc/serde/serde_json/uuid; sc-jev-py lists pyo3/serde_json/sc-observability; sc-agent-types lists [] omitting sc-observability-types (ADR-SAG-0016 binding edge), serde, sha2, thiserror, uuid; sc-jev omits toml/ureq; sc-jev-backends omits ureq; sc-jev-check omits toml/serde.
findings.remediation: Pick one convention (workspace crates only, or all direct non-dev deps) and make every boundary match Cargo.toml; at minimum record sc-agent-types -> sc-observability-types; add forbidden edge sc-ai -> sc-jev (ADR-SAG-0010).

findings.description: Phase A crate graph omits sc-treesitter and its edge to sc-agent-types (plan.md:112 shows it) and the sc-observability-types edge; does not say sc-treesitter ships a binary; line 3 'Status: Draft (Phase A planning)' despite Active ADRs; no ADR status table; ADR sections unordered.
findings.remediation: Add sc-treesitter to graph; set status Active; add ADR index table (id, status, amends/amended-by).

findings.description: ADR-SAG-0005 'sc-jev-check is the only crate that runs extractors' is now ambiguous next to ADR-SAG-0015 (sc-treesitter is a producer outside the judge); PayloadBuilder is pub but composition roots are told not to call it.
findings.remediation: Amend ADR-SAG-0005 to 'runs the four consumer extractor kinds'; consider making PayloadBuilder crate-private.
